Research and build a targeted list of potential clients — US/UK/AU marketing agencies, digital agencies, SMBs needing web dev outsourcing, and Indian businesses/agencies needing similar services
Write and send cold outreach — emails, LinkedIn messages, or other channels (you decide the best approach)
Set up or optimize my LinkedIn profile or agency profile on directories like Clutch, GoodFirms, or DesignRush if needed
Book at least 2–3 discovery calls with interested prospects (national or international), or hand over warm leads with contact details and conversation history

Percentage of project value paid out when a referred lead signs and pays (exact % to be discussed and agreed upfront)
Optional small per-qualified-lead bonus for leads that meet the target client profile, regardless of conversion (open to discussion)
Clear tracking of leads and deals via shared sheet/CRM so payouts are transparent

Marketing agencies in the US, UK, Canada or Australia looking for a white-label web and software development partner at affordable Indian rates
Small businesses in the US/UK without a website or with an outdated one — restaurants, real estate agents, law firms, education institutes, etc.
Indian businesses and agencies looking for web development, SEO, or digital marketing support

Professional websites delivered in 10–14 days

Proven experience in B2B lead generation for web and software development, digital marketing, or IT services

Experience with national (Indian) B2B outreach is a plus
Knowledge of cold email outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or agency partnership outreach

Comfortable working on a commission-only basis with performance-based earnings
Previous results — show me a campaign you ran and its outcome

Your exact strategy — what channels you'll use and why
A previous campaign example — what industry, what results
How many outreach contacts per day you can manage
Your proposed commission structure (% per deal)

full_description:
Commercial Building Renovation, CAD Drafting, Floor Plan Redesign & Energy Incentive Consultant (Indianapolis, IN)

We are redeveloping an approximately 8,100 square foot commercial retail building in Indianapolis, Indiana, and are looking for an experienced architectural designer, CAD draftsperson, engineer, or energy incentive consultant to assist with building design updates and maximizing available energy incentives.

This project involves converting an existing retail building into multiple tenant spaces, including a laundromat, convenience store, and cell phone store, while maximizing available utility rebates, tax incentives, and grant opportunities.

Project Scope

Phase 1, Existing Floor Plan Digitization & Layout Redesign

Our engineer has prepared a hand-drawn floor plan that needs to be converted into professional CAD drawings and revised based on updated project requirements.

The building footprint is approximately 134.7 ft × 59.8 ft (about 8,100 SF).

The selected person will:

* Convert the existing hand-drawn floor plan into professional AutoCAD (.DWG) drawings.
* Produce clean, dimensioned architectural floor plans.
* Reorganize the tenant layout while maintaining the existing building footprint.
* Coordinate the revised layout with our engineer.
* Update storefronts, entrances, and interior partition walls.

Proposed Tenant Layout

* Cell Phone Store: approximately 800 to 850 SF, with a side entrance.
* Convenience Store: approximately 3,100 SF, front entrance.
* Laundromat: approximately 3,700 to 3,800 SF, front entrance.

Utility & Electrical Coordination

The revised floor plan must incorporate the utility company’s preferred electrical layout.

This includes:

* Removing the last storefront glazing on the utility side of the building.
* Replacing that storefront with a brick masonry wall.
* Providing space for:
 * One 800A CT meter.
 * One 400A CT meter.
 * One 200A lever-bypass meter.
 * Associated disconnects and required working clearances.
* Coordinating the layout for a proposed pad-mounted transformer and utility service.
* Providing a layout suitable for review by our engineer and utility company.

⸻

Phase 2, Commercial Energy Incentives & Funding Strategy

We are also seeking assistance in identifying, securing, and maximizing every available energy incentive for this redevelopment.

The selected person will:

* Review architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing plans.
* Identify all available incentives through the AES Indiana 2026 Business Rebates & Incentives Program.
* Determine which improvements qualify for Prescriptive Rebates and which should be submitted as Custom Incentive projects.
* Recommend cost-effective energy efficiency upgrades that maximize available funding.
* Perform or coordinate energy modeling and engineering calculations required for incentive applications.
* Prepare and submit all required applications, calculations, engineering documentation, and supporting materials.
* Coordinate directly with AES Indiana, CLEAResult, utility representatives, inspectors, and program administrators.
* Identify additional federal, state, local, utility, tax credit, financing, and grant opportunities.
* Manage the incentive process from project design through final rebate payment.

⸻

Planned Building Improvements

* New rooftop HVAC systems.
* High-efficiency water heating equipment.
* Complete LED interior and exterior lighting.
* Lighting controls and occupancy sensors.
* Roof insulation upgrades.
* Wall insulation upgrades.
* High-performance storefront glazing.
* Electrical service upgrades.
* Building automation and energy management systems.
* Tenant improvements for a multi-tenant retail center.

⸻

Deliverables

* Professional AutoCAD (.DWG) drawings.
* Updated PDF floor plans.
* Revised tenant layout ready for engineering review.
* Utility equipment layout coordinated with the revised floor plan.
* Comprehensive energy incentive strategy.
* Estimated rebate value by measure.
* Cost-benefit analysis.
* Energy savings calculations.
* Complete incentive application package.
* Coordination with engineer, utility company, and contractors.
* Final rebate submission and closeout documentation.

⸻

Preferred Qualifications

* Commercial architectural drafting and AutoCAD experience.
* Experience converting hand-drawn plans into professional CAD drawings.
* Experience with commercial retail renovations, laundromats, mixed-use buildings, or adaptive reuse projects.
* Experience with AES Indiana Business Rebates & Incentives and CLEAResult.
* Strong knowledge of the Indiana Commercial Energy Conservation Code, ASHRAE 90.1, the Inflation Reduction Act, and Internal Revenue Code Section 179D.
* Licensed Professional Engineer (PE), Certified Energy Manager (CEM), Certified Energy Auditor (CEA), Building Energy Modeling Professional (BEMP), or equivalent credentials are preferred.

Please include examples of similar commercial renovation projects, experience with utility incentive programs, your proposed approach, estimated timeline, and fee structure.

full_description:
Project Title: B2B Toy Industry SDR Needed – Europe Distributor Research + Cold Calls for Hong Kong Meetings

We are looking for an experienced SDR / Sales Development Representative to support a B2B toy business project focused on preschool and boys’ toys.

The mission has two parts:

Lead research / data building
Identify relevant toy distributors based in Europe
Focus only on distributors with real commercial potential
Find the right decision-makers or buyers to contact
Collect direct contact details, especially mobile numbers, not only generic office numbers
Experience with tools such as Apollo, Lusha, Hunter, Kaspr, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar is expected
Cold calling / appointment setting
Call selected toy distributors and decision-makers
Follow up several times when needed
Qualify their interest
Book meetings for Hong Kong in October, when many European toy distributors attend the toy fairs / sourcing events

The mission will mainly take place during July and August, with a possible additional short campaign in early September. We may start with a 15-day test period in July, followed by another short period in September if the results are good.

We will provide guidance, company names and market insight, as we are already professionals in the toy industry. However, the freelancer must be able to complete the targeting, find the right contacts, and manage outbound calls professionally.

Requirements:

Proven experience in B2B cold calling and appointment setting
Strong English communication skills with a clear, neutral and professional phone voice
Ability to speak confidently with European business contacts
Experience in lead research and direct contact finding
Comfortable calling the same target several times if needed
Toy, consumer goods, retail or distribution experience is a strong plus

Before starting, we will run a short live call test to assess communication quality, phone approach and overall professionalism.

Please apply only if you are comfortable with both lead research and cold calling.

Applications without proven cold-calling experience will not be considered. This is not only a data research project; the main objective is to book qualified business meetings.
